officialFinding: Gyeongbokgung Palace AND the Royal Guard-Changing Ceremony are CLOSED EVERY TUESDAY (Nov 3 is not a public holiday).
actionRequired: Swap Day 3 (Tuesday Nov 3) and Day 4 (Wednesday Nov 4 — Seongsu), OR visit Changdeokgung / Deoksugung Palace on Tuesday (closed Mondays, open Tuesdays).

submittedText: Observatory 10:00-10:30 (entry until 10:00) | Cable Car Hours: 10:00-10:30

officialFinding: AM/PM omitted & closing hours misstated! Observatory (29,000 KRW) & Cable Car (15,000 KRW RT) are separate tickets.
actionRequired: Enjoy full daytime or sunset/night skyline window; buy separate tickets or use Bus 01A/01B (1,500 KRW).

officialFinding: Nov 2, 2006 was a Thursday, whereas all 9 weekday/date pairs in the itinerary match Oct 31 – Nov 9, 2026 (Sun Nov 1 through Mon Nov 9). Official landmark spelling is Namsan / N Seoul Tower.

officialFinding: Official AREX Express adult fare is 13,000 KRW (43 min T1 / 51 min T2 to Seoul Station only). Airport Limousine 6015 is 17,000 KRW directly to hotel block and requires buying a ticket at the ICN counter/kiosk before boarding.
actionRequired: With luggage for 2 adults, take Limousine Bus 6015 direct to 'Lotte Hotel / IBIS Myeong-dong' (right next to Stanford Hotel Myeongdong).

officialFinding: Official Crystal Jade Shinsegae Main Store page confirms weekday hours are 10:30–20:00 (weekends 10:30–20:30), closing much earlier than night markets; Lotte & Shinsegae also close 1 Monday per month.

officialFinding: Official Myeongdong Kyoja site confirms the Main Restaurant relocated and integrated in 2026 to 129, Toegye-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul (420 seats, 10:30–21:00 daily; closed New Year's Day & Chuseok only).

officialFinding: DDP (281 Eulji-ro, Jung-gu) is Zaha Hadid's futuristic curved museum/plaza in Dongdaemun (10:00–20:00). The 'converted industrial warehouses, fashion pop-ups & bakeries' description refers to Seongsu-dong itself (e.g., Daelim Changgo / Seongsu Yeonbang).
actionRequired: Keep BOTH if desired — DDP is right on Subway Line 2 between Myeongdong and Seongsu!

officialFinding: 'Chwihyang' (익선취향) and 'Favorite of Ikseon' refer to the same Ikseon-dong restaurant serving pork belly rosé pasta; 'Uri Wang Galbitang in Gangdong' is far outside Seongsu with unverified hours.
actionRequired: Drop 'Favorite of Ikseon-dong' from Day 4, book/queue at Ikseon Chwihyang ONCE on Day 6, and verify any Seongsu dinner alternative locally.

officialFinding: VisitSeoul confirms 'Rain Report Rainbow' (33-7 Supyo-ro 28-gil, 10:30–20:30 daily) is located in Ikseon-dong (across the street from Insadong), whereas Seongsu's Rain Report Croissant has unconfirmed 2026 operating hours.

issueType: Omitted Calendar Dates in Week 2 Headers
officialFinding: While Week 1 headers include calendar dates (Oct.31/Nov 1 through Nov 9), Week 2 headers (Days 9–16) omit month/day numbers and list only weekdays (Monday through Monday). Under the 2026 calendar where Nov 1 = Sunday and Nov 9 = Monday, Days 10–16 correspond to Tue Nov 10 through Mon Nov 16, 2026.
actionRequired: Confirm Nov 10–16, 2026 as the Week 2 travel dates before booking timed tickets (Sky Capsule, KTX, Mercure Ambassador Seoul Hongdae).

submittedText: 5. Take the Sky Capsule toward Cheongsapo... Book round trip tickets. 6. If you don’t book round trip capsule train tickets, walk the Cheongsapo Daritdol Observatory
issueType: One-Way Ticket Rule, 2026 Fare Update & Skywalk Walk Misconception
officialFinding: 1. Official Haeundae Blueline Park sells Sky Capsule tickets ONE-WAY per cabin (Mipo -> Cheongsapo or Cheongsapo -> Mipo), NOT as a single round-trip Sky Capsule ticket. To return by rail, travelers must either book a separate reverse Sky Capsule slot or buy the official Package (one-way Sky Capsule + all-stops Beach Train). 2. Official Korean vs English pages show a 2026 fare transition (40,000 KRW vs 50,000 KRW for a 2-seat cabin one-way), so exact price is left blank in the verified table. 3. Cheongsapo Daritdol Observatory (167 Cheongsapo-ro, open 09:00–21:00 Sep–Nov, free) is a 5–8 min walk east of Cheongsapo Station — visit it regardless of whether you hold a return ticket; walking the Daritdol skywalk does not walk you back to Haeundae.
actionRequired: Book Mipo -> Cheongsapo Sky Capsule in advance on bluelinepark.com (sales open 4 weeks ahead), walk 5–8 min to Cheongsapo Daritdol Observatory, and return to Mipo/Haeundae via the Haeundae Beach Train, a second one-way Sky Capsule, or Village Bus Haeundae-gu 2.
officialSourceLabel: VisitKorea — Haeundae Blueline Park & Cheongsapo Daritdol

day: Day 10 (#7) & Day 12 (#2) — BUSAN X the SKY
submittedText: Day 10 #7: 'Late afternoon: Visit Busan X the Sky -optional. $17.59 on klook.' AND Day 12 #2: '10:00am-11:30am -Busan X the SKY. Visit the observation deck in the LCT Landmaek Tower... Hours: 10am-9pm.'
issueType: Duplicate Attraction Scheduling, Reseller Price & Typo ('Landmaek')
officialFinding: BUSAN X the SKY (30 Dalmaji-gil, LCT Landmark Tower 98–100F, open 10:00–21:00, last entry 20:30) is scheduled twice: as an optional late-afternoon stop on Day 10 right after Mipo/Cheongsapo, and again as the primary 10:00–11:30 AM activity on Day 12. Official VisitKorea adult admission is 29,000 KRW (child/senior 26,000 KRW), whereas '$17.59 on klook' is a third-party OTA discount estimate. Draft also contains typo 'LCT Landmaek Tower'.
actionRequired: Visit BUSAN X the SKY once — either on Day 10 late afternoon (since Mipo Blueline Park Station is a 3-minute walk from LCT Landmark Tower) OR on Day 12 morning before SEA LIFE Busan Aquarium.
officialSourceLabel: VisitKorea — BUSAN X the SKY Official Listing

submittedText: 2. Walk towards Dongbaekseon Island (west end of Haeundae Beach-Busan’s best known waterfrond attractions...). 4. Visit Nurimaru APEC House. Admission is free

officialFinding: Official spelling is Dongbaekseom Island (동백섬). VisitKorea confirms Nurimaru APEC House (116 Dongbaek-ro) is free and open 09:00–18:00 (last admission 17:00), closed on the first Monday of every month (open on Tuesday Day 10).

submittedText: 2. Take the 2 buses to get to Gamcheon Culture Village. 1 hr & 17 min. 3. Spend 2-3 hours wandering the alleys, viewpoints, art installations & shops.
issueType: Residential Visiting Curfew (09:00–18:00) & Unspecified 2-Bus Route vs Metro+Village Bus
officialFinding: 1. Official VisitKorea Special Management Zone guidelines restrict tourist visits in Gamcheon Culture Village residential alleys to 09:00–18:00 (Info Center 09:00–17:00 Nov–Feb / 09:00–18:00 Mar–Oct). 2. Draft cites '2 buses / 1 hr & 17 min' without route numbers; taking Busan Metro Line 2 (Haeundae) -> Line 1 (Toseong Station Exit 6) -> Village Bus Saha 1-1 / Seo-gu 2 / Seo-gu 2-2 takes ~68 min (~1,800 KRW with free 30-min transfer) and avoids downtown surface congestion.
actionRequired: Visit Gamcheon Culture Village during daytime hours (09:00–17:00) and use Toseong Station Exit 6 + Village Bus Saha 1-1 / Seo-gu 2 / Seo-gu 2-2.
officialSourceLabel: VisitKorea — Gamcheon Culture Village Special Management Zone Guidelines

Official hours and cost are left blank.

day: Day 11 (#5–#10 — BIFF Square, Jagalchi Market, Songdo & Nampo-dong)
submittedText: 5. Lunch: Take bus to BIFF Square... 6. Walk to Jagalchi Fish Market. 7. Take bus to Songdo Beach... 10. Late Afternoon: Head into the old downtown area: -Jagalchi Market -BIFF Square... -Gukje Marker -Nampo-dong shopping streets | 9.
issueType: In-Day Backtracking (BIFF Square & Jagalchi Listed Twice), Market Closure Rules, Typos & Trailing '9.'
officialFinding: 1. Day 11 visits BIFF Square and Jagalchi Fish Market at #5–#6, leaves for Songdo Beach/Cloud Trails/Cable Car at #7–#9, and then returns to the exact same Jagalchi Market & BIFF Square at #10 before Gukje Market & Nampo-dong. 2. Official market closure rules per VisitKorea: Jagalchi Market (05:00–22:00) is closed 1st & 3rd Tuesdays; Gukje Market (09:00–20:00) is closed 1st & 3rd Sundays; Nampo Underground Shopping Center (10:00–20:00) is closed 2nd Tuesdays (Wednesday Nov 11 avoids all three!). 3. Draft contains typos 'atmospher', 'Gukje Marker', and a trailing empty line '9.' after item 10.
actionRequired: Consolidate Nampo-dong (BIFF Square, Jagalchi Market, Gukje Market, Gwangbok-ro Fashion Street) into a single block either before OR after Songdo Beach so you do not backtrack twice.
officialSourceLabel: VisitKorea — Jagalchi Market, BIFF Square & Gukje Market

'Haeundae Shopping' in the Day 12 header has no numbered item, and '5. Dinner:' is blank.

day: Day 16 (#3–#4 — Haeundae to Busan Station & KTX to Seoul)
submittedText: 3. Take uber to Busan Station. (1 hour ride, $20-$30) 4. Take KTX train to Seoul. Get off at Seoul Station.
issueType: Unverified Taxi Time/Cost Estimate & Unbooked KTX Train
officialFinding: Uber/taxi travel time ('1 hour ride') and USD cost ('$20-$30') from L7 HAEUNDAE to Busan Station depend on Monday morning road traffic and meter rates and cannot be verified from an official tariff source. By contrast, Busan Metro Line 2 (Haeundae) -> Seomyeon -> Line 1 (Busan Station) takes ~42 minutes for a fixed 1,800 KRW adult fare. KTX departure time and seat reservation are not yet specified (standard adult fare 54,400 KRW).
actionRequired: Allow buffer time if taking a taxi on Monday morning, or take Busan Metro Line 2 -> Line 1 (~42 min, 1,800 KRW) directly into Busan Station; reserve KTX tickets on KORAIL.
officialSourceLabel: Busan Metropolitan City — Public Transportation & KORAIL

day: Day 16 (#5–#6 — AREX to Hongik Univ. Station & Walk to Mercure Ambassador Seoul Hongdae)
submittedText: 5. Take AREX from Seoul Station to Hongdae. Get off at Hongik Univ. Station. 6. Walk to Mercure Ambassador Seoul Hongdae. 8 minute walk.
issueType: AREX All-Stop vs Express Boarding Trap & Exit 8 (Elevator) vs Exit 9 (Stairs) Walk
officialFinding: 1. At Seoul Station, travelers MUST board the AREX **All-Stop Train (일반열차, B3)** (2 stops: Seoul Station -> Gongdeok -> Hongik Univ. Station, ~7 min, 1,550 KRW T-money). Do NOT board the AREX Express Train (B2), which runs nonstop to Incheon Airport and does NOT stop at Hongik Univ. Station! 2. Official Accor hotel page lists Mercure Ambassador Seoul Hongdae (144 Yanghwa-ro, Mapo-gu; check-in 15:00 / check-out 12:00) as a 2-minute walk from Hongik Univ. Station Exit 9 (stairs), or ~4–5 minutes from Exit 8 (elevator recommended for suitcases), plus ~5–6 minutes walking underground from the AREX platform to the Line 2 exits.
actionRequired: Board AREX All-Stop at Seoul Station B3 to Hongik Univ. Station, follow underground transfer signs to Exit 8 (elevator) with luggage, and enter Mercure Ambassador Seoul Hongdae via the rear building entrance up to the 4F lobby.
officialSourceLabel: Accor Official — Mercure Ambassador Seoul Hongdae
